 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. LeBron James went viral after a wild moment he shared with a fan courtside, and NBA fans couldn't wrap their minds around it. 
 The Philadelphia 76ers beat the Chicago Bulls comfortably on Monday night to improve to a 7-1 record. Their new team has been excellent in their brief time together on the court so far. The superstars are all meshing well, and LeBron James has fitted seamlessly into this new group.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Tyrese Maxey led the way in scoring once more for Philly in their 126-107 victory. However, Jaylen Brown wasn't far behind and VJ Edgecombe managed to get 21 points as well. LeBron James was tied with Joel Embiid at 15 points, but one non-basketball moment from the King is what went viral online.
 LeBron James went viral for taking a sip from one fan's drink after a play saw him land up in the crowd
 There was one moment in the game when LeBron seemingly wanted to save the ball from going out of bounds. He wasn't able to control his momentum and ended up with the fans sitting right behind the basket at the lowest level.
 What led to the situation causing a stir on social media is that James quickly took a sip from a fan's cup, and many on social media couldn't quite believe it.
 "If Bron sips my drink, I'm not mad, I'm framing the cup," one fan claimed. "Y'all are worried about the drink, I'm thinking how much someone might pay for that glass," another fan said. "LeBron is having some extra fun with it in year 24," a third fan claimed.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "That fan's gonna tell this story for 40 years and the drink gets stronger every time," a fourth fan observed. "That diet coke gon fetch a thousand bucks on eBay ong," a different comment read. "LeBron is just moving different in Philly, you love to see it," a sixth fan wrote.
 For the King, it just goes to show how relaxed he already is in Philadelphia with his new team. They seem to be going strong early too, and their goal will be nothing short of the first seed in the Eastern Conference.
